rules.statement: The plaintiff must prove that a definite sum of money is due on the mortgage bond before succeeding against a third party in possession of the mortgaged premises.
rules.supporting_quote: "It accordingly appears to me to be clear that if the plaintiff has proved (as he appears to have substantially done) his mortgage, his mortgagor's title at the time of the mortgage, and that the mortgage debt is still unpaid, he is entitled to a decree in his favour declaring the property liable to be sold to satisfy that debt."
